We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: father (张某) and wife gave birth to twins, early, then he demanded hospital abandon treatment and gave the babies to a taxi driver to abandon. This is abandonment of infants. In Chinese criminal law, abandoning a child is a crime: "遗弃罪" (abandonment). Also possibly "故意杀人未遂"? No, they didn't kill, just abandon. Could be "非法收养"? Not exactly. The crime is "遗弃罪" (abandonment of a minor). Also possibly "虐待儿童"? But abandonment is separate. The examples: For kidnapping children, they used "拐骗儿童". For abandonment, maybe "遗弃罪". In Chinese law, "遗弃罪" is under article 261 of Criminal Law: abandoning a minor under 14 years old, or a disabled person, etc. So answer: [罪名]遗弃罪<eoa>. Possibly also "故意伤害"? No. So single crime.
